reviews.summary: No current, directly relevant security, network, or TAO trading disruption was found. A Bittensor basket-trading upgrade remains testnet-only and disabled on mainnet, so it is not an active spot-TAO execution risk. ([preview.bittensor.com](https://preview.bittensor.com/docs/guides/basket-trading?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: Bittensor’s v461 basket-trading functionality is documented as live on testnet but not yet on mainnet; its network-wide trading switch defaults off until governance enables it. ([preview.bittensor.com](https://preview.bittensor.com/docs/guides/basket-trading?utm_source=openai))

Kraken’s status page lists Bittensor (TAO) as operational; it notes degraded digital-currency funding generally and possible EUR/GBP deposit/withdrawal delays, not a TAO trading halt. ([status.kraken.com](https://status.kraken.com/?utm_source=openai))

A Coinbase TAO send/receive delay on September 21, 2026 was resolved in roughly 34 minutes; buys and sells were reported unaffected. ([isdown.app](https://isdown.app/status/coinbase/incidents/658262-tao-delayed-sends-receives?utm_source=openai))
